results.title: Half Past
results.overview: A team of con artists learns the value of trust during a heist where everything goes wrong.

results.title: Nikola Tesla's 19hz
results.overview: Nikola Tesla-visionary, inventor, genius. The world remembers his groundbreaking discoveries, but few know the secret that consumed his final years: a relentless quest to reach the other side.

results.title: Petros Eni
results.overview: In an immersion into the little-known Necropolis upon which the foundations of St. Peter's Basilica rest, we will learn the story of the tomb of the first apostle. The first Pope, the "rock" upon which all of Christianity was built and which has cemented the history not only of the Catholic religion, but of all Western civilization. A fascinating journey through a sacred place that has survived for millennia and whose history is intertwined with the life of the apostle himself and the construction of the Basilica, which in 2026, when Petros Eni arrives in the rooms, will celebrate the 400th anniversary of its inauguration.

results.title: Lydia and the Mist Rider
results.original_title: Lydia et le vaisseau des tempêtes
results.overview: When her older brother Thaddeus is mysteriously kidnapped by the Spellbinder, 11-year-old Lydia sets off to find him in the Misty Sea. Picked up by the crew of a flying ship, the Dolphin, Lydia becomes the apprentice of Ambrosia, a Stargazer. Ambrosia is trying to find other children who have disappeared, including her own son. Determined to solve the mystery, Lydia must learn stargazing magic and ready herself to confront the Spellbinder.

results.title: Sensitive Subject
results.overview: Issa and his friends want to make a film about bullying. Their limited knowledge of the subject is leading them down the wrong path. Their friend Maïmouna, a young feminist filmmaker, tries to help them get back on track.

results.title: The Liars
results.overview: Matías and his younger brother Jaime are left to their own devices in an adult world. When Jaime is caught stealing, Matías must convince a stranger to act as their father.

results.title: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
results.overview: Three Kerala Police officers venture into a mysterious forest on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border to find a missing officer. They encounter strange time-related phenomena, uncovering the hidden secrets of Velloorkkatt forest.

results.title: Whatever It Takes
results.overview: Rose and Jean have nothing in common. Rose is a force of nature who faces all her problems with a disarming joie de vivre. She lives with her 3 children upstairs in the family hotel that no longer belongs to her. They're not poor, they're broke... but only temporarily. Jean is a solitary, taciturn man who has buried his big heart under layers of modesty and resignation. When he arrives in this unusual family, however, he quickly becomes indispensable. What did they expect before they met? Probably nothing. He soon becomes indispensable.

results.title: Under Your Feet
results.overview: Isabel moves with her two children into a very prestigious building that has a very peculiar admission method but at a very affordable rental fee. Once approved and settled, three elderly neighbors from the lower floor will turn their lives upside down.

results.title: Cam Girl
results.overview: CAM GIRL is a romance drama about four cam models at four very different points in their careers. It moves between the noise of the adult industry and the quiet, often lonely life on the other side of the camera.  Alana is a grocery store clerk in Medellín who can’t cover her grandfather’s medicine when her best friend Roxana tells her to try camming. Sally is a rising cam star in Cyprus, still grieving her father and losing herself in everything her new life can buy. Hope is a perfectionist who hides what she does from the man she’s falling for, hoping he’s the one thing she’s missing. Lexi is an industry icon pulled in every direction, shut off from the real world and from herself.  Their stories cross, and together they show what life as a cam girl actually looks like.

results.title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
results.original_title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
results.overview: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

results.title: Stabby Chic
results.overview: A Man notices strange killings happening by the dumpster near his apartment. He investigates only to be pulled into the dumpster to a world where all the trash is out to kill him.

results.title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
results.overview: A group of vampires confronts the challenges of adapting to contemporary society while grappling with their own mortality, all while engaged in a conflict with a dangerous enemy.

results.title: blood & soil
results.overview: A young man attends a rally.

results.title: Crude Awakenings
results.overview: At a ruthless PR firm, an ambitious publicist takes on a notorious energy company at the promise of a promotion. As a mysterious sickness spreads throughout her firm, she must decide whether to sacrifice her morals in favour of corporate success.

results.title: Wait For Me To Be Successful Later
results.overview: Facing constant ridicule from his successful relatives every Eid, an unemployed man desperately races to secure a job before the 2026 family gathering to save his dignity and support his struggling family.

results.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
results.original_title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
results.overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

results.title: Memento Mori
results.overview: Memento Mori is a techno-horror short film about Silas, a man in his thirties who works as a content moderator. His job pushes him to the brink as he repeatedly wades through extremely violent and sexually explicit videos and imagery. These repeated viewings cause him to obsess over his mortal and corporeal self, spiraling him into mind-bending departures from reality. His existential concerns are compounded only further as he grieves the death of his father and a past that continues to haunt him.

results.title: Yellow Eyes
results.overview: A young couple inherits a house containing a mysterious relic that hosts the spirit of a powerful demon, and the wife of the man it possesses must find an exorcist to save him.

results.title: Me Before Me
results.overview: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.
